operations.description: Read MIME text, headers, labels, and attachment references. If incomplete is true, do not claim a complete message.

arguments.name: id
arguments.description: Exact id from a prior read.

transform.source:
return function(response)
 local d=json.decode(response.body); d=d.message or d
 local incomplete=false; local content=""; local attachments=json.array()
 local function visit(p)
  local b=p.body or {}; local mime=p.mimeType or ""
  if b.attachmentId then attachments[#attachments+1]={id=b.attachmentId,filename=p.filename or "",mime_type=mime,size=b.size or 0} end
  if (mime=="text/plain" or mime=="text/html") and b.data then
   local ok,value=pcall(text.decode_base64url_utf8,b.data,2001)
   if ok then content=content..value.."\n"; if #(b.data)>2668 then incomplete=true end else incomplete=true end
  elseif b.data and b.data~="" then incomplete=true end
  for _,part in ipairs(p.parts or {}) do visit(part) end
 end
 visit(d.payload or {})
 local headers=json.encode((d.payload or {}).headers or json.array())
 local files=json.encode(attachments)
 if #headers>800 then headers=""; incomplete=true end
 if #files>1000 then files=""; incomplete=true end
 if #content>2000 then content=text.truncate_utf8(content,2000); incomplete=true end
 local labels=d.labelIds or json.array(); if #labels>12 then labels=json.array(); incomplete=true end
 return {id=d.id,thread_id=d.threadId,headers_json=headers,labels=labels,text=content,attachments_json=files,incomplete=incomplete}
end

operations.description: List up to 30 message IDs in a thread. Read each with get_message. Check incomplete.

arguments.name: id
arguments.description: Exact id from a prior read.

transform.source: return function(response) local d=json.decode(response.body); local a=json.array(); for i,m in ipairs(d.messages or {}) do if i<=30 then a[#a+1]=m.id end end; return {id=d.id,message_ids=a,incomplete=#(d.messages or {})>30} end

operations.description: Read base64url attachment bytes up to 4096 encoded bytes. If too_large is true, the bytes were omitted.

arguments.name: messageId
arguments.description: Exact messageId from a prior read.

arguments.name: id
arguments.description: Exact id from a prior read.

transform.source: return function(response) local d=json.decode(response.body); local s=d.data or ""; return {data=#s<=4096 and s or "",size=d.size,too_large=#s>4096} end

operations.description: List drafts. Follow continuation and read selected drafts.

transform.source: return function(response) local d=json.decode(response.body); local out=json.array(); for _,v in ipairs(d.drafts or {}) do local s=json.encode(v); out[#out+1]={id=v.id,record_json=#s<=600 and s or "",too_large=#s>600} end; return {records=out} end
